snippet.title: Tempopo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Tempopo is OUT NOW 🌷🎶
on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Game Pass, Steam, Nintendo Switch

Hana's garden has been scattered the winds—and needs the Tempopo to help her collect the flowers and bring them home. BUT the Tempopo are a little... well, chaotic. You'll set up instructions to help them move around the island, avoid hazards, collect flowers, and solve the puzzle. 

This is Witch Beam's third game, after Assault Android Cactus and Unpacking. 

Buy now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/318840/Tempopo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/tempopo/9P6X0VL8BXZF
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/tempopo-switch/

Join Tempopo mailing list: https://www.tempopogame.com/
TikTok  https://tiktok.com/@tempopogame 
Bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/tempopogame.com
